instruction: When I run 'node' command, I get "command not found". I have installed Node.js via nvm. Could you help me initialize nvm in my shell configuration so that node commands work?

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5); pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 'alt', 't'); time.sleep(0.5)

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding nvm initialization to .bashrc (similar to conda initialization). Evaluator checks if NVM_DIR variable is set in .bashrc. Nearly identical pattern to the original conda task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly tests that node commands work after nvm initialization by sourcing ~/.bashrc and running 'node --version'
Command logic is sound: sources .bashrc to load nvm initialization, runs node command, validates version output format with grep pattern '^v[0-9]'
Complete coverage: verifies the actual goal stated in instruction ('node commands work'), not just presence of config text
Getter 'get_vm_command_line' appropriately executes shell commands via VM interface and returns output
Expected value '1\n' correctly represents successful verification
Metric 'exact_match' is appropriate for this boolean success/failure check
